Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging

Interface Release

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultStagingReleaseManager.ReleaseImpl
    public interface Release
    Data structure with metadata information about a release. This must only be created within the StagingReleaseManager.

    • Method Detail

      • getUuid

        @NotNull
@NotNull String getUuid()
        The UUID of the top node with the release data. You can store this as property type PropertyType.REFERENCE somewhere to make sure a published release is not deleted.

      • getNumber

        @NotNull
@NotNull String getNumber()
        Release number (JCR compatible) of the release: this is automatically created with ReleaseNumberCreator and will be something like r4 or r2.4.5 . The current release is called "current".

      • getReleaseLabel

        @NotNull
default @NotNull String getReleaseLabel()
        Returns the label that is set on the versions, additionally to being stored in the content copy. This is "composum-release-"{number} - except for the current release where it's called "composum-release-"current, since a label must not contain a colon.

      • getPath

        @NotNull
@NotNull String getPath()
        Path to internal release node. This is an unique identifier for the release, but use sparingly since this is implementation dependent.

      • getReleaseRoot

        @NotNull
@NotNull org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource getReleaseRoot()
        The resource that is the top of the working tree - a "cpl:releaseRoot".

      • getMetaDataNode

        @NotNull
@NotNull org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource getMetaDataNode()
        The resource that contains metadata for this release. This is not touched by the StagingReleaseManager and can be freely used to store additional metadata. If you want to change it, just retrieve the Release object and write on the resource returned here - the StagingReleaseManager does not care about its contents.

      • getChangeNumber

        @NotNull
@NotNull String getChangeNumber()
        An UID that changes on each release content change. If it's constant, you can rely on the release content being the same. (Unless for changes not using the StagingReleaseManager, which you shouldn't do, of course. At least not without calling #bumpReleaseChangeNumber(Release), too.)

      • getMarks

        @NotNull
@NotNull List<String> getMarks()
        The marks that point to this release. Each mark can only point to exactly one release.

      • isClosed

        boolean isClosed()
        If true the StagingReleaseManager will refuse to change the releases contents.

        @Nullable
@Nullable Release getPreviousRelease()
                              throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException

        Throws:

      • appliesToPath

        boolean appliesToPath​(@Nullable
                      @Nullable String path)
        Checks whether the given path is in the range of the release root. This does not check whether the resource actually exists.
        Parameters:
        path - an absolute path
        Returns:
        true if it's within the tree spanned by the release root.

      • absolutePath

        @NotNull
@NotNull String absolutePath​(@Nullable
                             @Nullable String path)
                      throws IllegalArgumentException
        Maps the relative path to the absolute path ( getReleaseRoot() + '/' + relativePath ) ; if it's already an absolute path into the release this returns it unmodified. If it's a path into the interal release store, it's transformed to the absolute path into the content that corresponds to that path. If it does not belong to the release at all, an IllegalArgumentException is thrown. For an empty path, the release root is returned.
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException
